title: Tytuvėnai Monastery Servants’ House

terrainReference.basis: Unmodified open elevation tile data sampled at the independent building anchor.

mapIdentity.provider: Lithuanian GRPK registry footprint and individual Cultural Heritage Register location
mapIdentity.scope: The register locates the servants’ house in the east part of the contiguous record. Its survey length is used to partition the exact mapped exterior.

note: One-storey servants’ house with plastered brick walls, a gabled tile roof, molded chimney and rectangular openings.
